Demurrer to Complaint

Hearing Date: March 13, 2026

Department: C-65

Judge: Honorable Karen S. Hewitt

 

Defendant Pacific Property Management LLC demurs to the Second and Third Causes of Action of Plaintiff's Complaint.

 

The demurrer to the Second Cause of Action (Negligence) is OVERRULED. Plaintiff has sufficiently alleged a duty of care owed by Defendant as property manager.

 

The demurrer to the Third Cause of Action (Breach of Contract) is SUSTAINED WITH LEAVE TO AMEND. Plaintiff has failed to allege the specific contractual provisions that were breached. Plaintiff shall have 20 days from the date of this order to file an amended complaint.
